**BLUF:** Tazewell County residents received a scam warning from the Sheriff’s Office on Oct. 22 about impersonators targeting families of inmates. A new countywide volunteer fire company became operational Oct. 15 with plans for paid support. In neighboring Mercer County, WV, Visit Mercer County’s Basecamp visitor center opened today in downtown Princeton. A proposed fuel cell energy project using coal mine methane is advancing at a former high school site in Buchanan County, VA.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Tazewell County, VA** — The Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office warned the public Oct. 22 about scammers posing as court or pretrial service employees. The callers contact families of inmates and request credit card information or money to assist the inmate. Officials stated that legitimate pretrial and court employees will not request money this way. A separate ongoing scam involves callers impersonating officers and threatening jail time unless money is sent. Residents are advised not to provide information or money over the phone.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)

Nothing else reported in the core or region in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Tazewell County, VA** — The Tazewell County Volunteer Fire Co. became operational Oct. 15 after the merger of 11 volunteer departments into a single countywide structure with three battalions. The change addresses recruitment, funding, and training challenges while keeping existing stations open. A paid part-time department is planned to begin operations in spring 2027 with a three-person 24/7 engine.[[2]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/22/sjn-tazewell-county-restructuring/)

Nothing else reported in the core or region in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Princeton, Mercer County, WV** — Visit Mercer County opened its new Basecamp visitor experience center today (Oct. 23) at 858 Mercer St. in downtown Princeton. The center provides visitor information, maps, merchandise, and promotes county attractions; it is open Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/22/base-camp-reached-visit-mercer-county-opens-princeton-office/)

**Buchanan County, VA** — Diversified Energy is developing a fuel cell project at the former Twin Valley High School property near Whitewood to convert coal mine methane into electricity. The initial phase would generate about 1.6 megawatts; a community meeting was held this week. The project is expected to create 10–20 jobs.[[4]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/23/diversified-energy-project/)

**Bluefield, Mercer County, WV** — Princeton Community Hospital earned chest pain certification (reported Oct. 22).[[5]](https://efis.psc.mo.gov/Document/Display/892454)

**Bluefield, Mercer County, WV** — Renovation work is underway on the former Graham Jewelry Building in downtown Bluefield (reported Oct. 22).[[6]](https://www.wvva.com/video/2026/10/15/base-camp-by-visit-mercer-county-opens-october-23rd/)
